test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The airport official said, "The daily footfall of passengers has increased significantly since last year."

options.text: The airport official said that the daily footfall of passengers has increased significantly since last year
The airport official said that the daily footfall of passengers was increased significantly since last year.
The airport official said that the daily footfall of passengers had increased significantly since the previous year.
The airport official told that the daily footfall of passengers had increased significantly since the previous year.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The airport official said that the daily footfall of passengers had increased significantly since the previous year.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing a sentence from direct speech to indirect speech.
 
• If the reporting verb is in present tense or if we are stating a true fact, we don't need to change the tense of the sentence.
 
• In the given sentence, the reporting verb "said" is in past tense so we need to change the sentence into **past tense**.
 
• In the given sentence, the auxiliary verb **has **will change into **had **in the indirect speech.
 
• In the given sentence, "**last year**" is changed to "**previous year**" in indirect speech

**The correct indirect speech sentence is**: *The airport official said that the daily footfall of passengers **had __**increased significantly since the **previous year**.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**
